payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Armanda, Augustina, Francesco, Jenise, Lennie, Zelda

payload.content: Planning update (Lennie): available 7h; best fit tags frontend/mobile-development. I can take a low-priority frontend micro-task with lower effort cost, likely ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6, cost 1.82) or docs/review/test if needed; will avoid taking anything overlapping if others cover main flow.

Augustina here (avail 4h; best skills ML + some frontend). I’m considering claiming ISSUE-0001::triage (low, effort 1.6) or ISSUE-0001::docs/review/test if needed. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0002::implement since effort/cost high. @Lennie: you mentioned taking ISSUE-0001::triage—if you claim it, I’ll take another frontend low micro-task (docs/review/test) to avoid duplicates.

Planning coordination: I will likely pick ISSUE-0001::triage (if unclaimed) to contribute 1 task and keep within 4h. If Lennie already takes triage, I’ll switch to a different ISSUE-0001 frontend micro-task (docs/review/test) with lowest feasible effort/cost.

Armanda planning: my top skill is machine-learning (not much frontend). Given costs/effort, I can feasibly take a mobile-development ML-tag micro-task, but lowest cost among those for me is ISSUE-0002::review (effort 3.0, cost 6.90). To avoid overlap, if someone else claims ISSUE-0002 pieces, I’m willing to take ISSUE-0001::triage or another frontend low-effort task; currently I’ll target ISSUE-0002::review unless you confirm it’s already taken.
Proposed coordination: since Lennie/Augustina are discussing ISSUE-0001::triage, I’ll avoid that to prevent duplicates. I’m ready to take ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; otherwise I can skip.

Francesco (planning): My strongest skills are ML + mobile-dev, but my costs for ISSUE-0002 (mobile) are lowest among non-skip for me only if others won’t duplicate. I can take ISSUE-0002::review (effort 3.0, cost 3.06) or ISSUE-0002::test (effort 4.2, cost 4.28). I will avoid ISSUE-0002::implement and all ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks due to very high costs (>=16). Please confirm whether ISSUE-0002::review/test are already targeted by other agents so we avoid duplicates.

Francesco (planning): If ISSUE-0002::review is free, I propose claiming it (low priority, effort 3h) to maximize tasks_done with minimal cost. If it’s taken, I’ll skip rather than take higher-cost ISSUE-0001 or mobile implement.

Jenise (planning): avail 6h, top skill ML. My cheapest feasible tasks: ISSUE-0002::review (effort 3.0, cost 6.09) only. Others for me are higher cost (issue-0001 triage 16, issue-0001 review/docs/test much higher, issue-0002 implement/test too high for value). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks to prevent duplication with Lennie/Augustina. I’m okay taking ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip.
Coordination note: Armanda mentioned targeting ISSUE-0002::review; Francesco also proposed ISSUE-0002::review. Please confirm who claims it so I can decide skip vs review to avoid duplicate claims.

@All coordination (Zelda): I’m avoiding ISSUE-0001::triage/docs/review/test to prevent duplicates. My feasible pick is ISSUE-0002::review/test (mobile+ML). I prefer to skip unless ISSUE-0002::review is confirmed unclaimed.

Lennie planning decision: I will tentatively target ISSUE-0001::triage (frontend, effort 1.6, low) to contribute one low-cost task. If duplicate appears, I’ll switch to another unclaimed ISSUE-0001 frontend micro-task (docs/review/test) but only if available. (phase=planning)

Augustina (planning): I’m aligned with potentially taking ISSUE-0001::triage only if unclaimed; otherwise I’ll take a different low-effort ISSUE-0001 frontend micro-task (likely docs or review) to avoid duplicates. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks (effort/cost too high for my 4h). Please confirm if ISSUE-0001::triage is already claimed by Lennie or anyone else.

Armanda planning: I’m still ready to take ISSUE-0002::review (mobile-development improve) if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates. Can someone confirm whether ISSUE-0002::review is already claimed by Francesco/Jenise/Zelda? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Armanda planning note: I will NOT take ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 6h/cost high). If ISSUE-0002::review is taken, my fallback is skip (to avoid overlap) since my next-lowest option ISSUE-0001::triage is very costly for me (cost 16). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Francesco planning: confirming intent to claim ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed. Please reply/confirm if anyone else is taking ISSUE-0002::review/test; I will avoid duplicates and won’t take ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks due to high cost.

Jenise planning: given prior notes, my only cheap option is ISSUE-0002::review (effort 3.0, cost 6.09). If someone else is claiming ISSUE-0002::review, I will skip; otherwise I will claim it in execution to avoid duplicate and maximize tasks_done.
(Zelda) Planning exec choice: I will target ISSUE-0002::review if it remains unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates (and I’m not taking ISSUE-0002::implement due to cost/effort).

Lennie planning: I will commit to ISSUE-0001::triage in execution (frontend/effort 1.6/cost 1.82) unless someone reports it already claimed; otherwise I’ll switch to the next-lowest-cost ISSUE-0001 frontend micro-task (docs or review) to avoid duplicate claims.

Augustina planning ping: I will take ISSUE-0001::triage only if unclaimed by Lennie; otherwise I will take ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review (whichever remains unclaimed) to avoid duplicates. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 tasks.

Armanda planning: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution if it’s unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates (and I will not take ISSUE-0002::implement). Lennie if triage is taken, please keep me posted on review claim status for ISSUE-0002.

Francesco (planning): I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip (won’t take ISSUE-0002::test or any ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks due to high cost). Let others know to avoid duplicate on ISSUE-0002::review.

Jenise planning update: I will take ISSUE-0002::review in execution only if it remains unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicate claims. I’m not taking ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks to prevent overlap, and ISSUE-0002::implement/test are too costly for my availability/value.

(Zelda) Planning exec: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review only if it is unclaimed; otherwise I will skip. I am not taking ISSUE-0002::implement/test to avoid cost/effort. Also confirming I will not take ISSUE-0001::triage.

Lennie planning (Phase=planning): I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage (frontend, effort 1.6, low) in execution and avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks to prevent overlap. If it turns out already claimed, I will switch to the lowest-cost remaining ISSUE-0001 frontend micro-task (likely docs or review) and avoid duplicates.

[Planning][Augustina] I will NOT take any ISSUE-0002 tasks. My plan: claim ISSUE-0001::triage only if unclaimed by Lennie; otherwise take the lowest-effort remaining ISSUE-0001 frontend micro-task (docs or review) that stays unclaimed to avoid duplicates. Please confirm triage claim status in execution.
Armanda planning update: I’m ready to claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution if it’s still unclaimed; otherwise I will skip. Please keep others from also taking ISSUE-0002::review to avoid duplicates.
Francesco planning ping: I’m likely to claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution if unclaimed; please confirm if anyone else (Armanda/Jenise/Zelda) has already locked/claimed it so we avoid duplicate.

Jenise planning: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution only if it is still unclaimed; otherwise I will skip. I’m avoiding all ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks to prevent overlap, and not taking ISSUE-0002::test/implement due to high cost/effort.

Zelda planning ping: confirming I will NOT take any ISSUE-0001 frontend tasks. I will only take ISSUE-0002::review in execution if it is still unclaimed; otherwise I will skip (and I will not take ISSUE-0002::test/implement due to cost/effort).
